metadata.title: Why Anthropic’s IPO is likely a victory lap for Amazon - MarketWatch

content.text:
13 hours ago
Why Anthropic’s IPO is likely a victory lap for Amazon
Amazon will be one of Anthropic's biggest shareholders following its initial public offering, with Alphabet not far behind.
Anthropic said in a filing this week that Amazon will own 33.9% of its outstanding Class N common stock and 14.7% of capital shares. If Amazon converted its notes in full, it would own 48.2% of Anthropic Class N shares and 23.8% of its capital stock.
Google will also own 31.6% of Anthropic's Class N shares and 13.7% of its outstanding capital stock, Anthropic disclosed.
